items.title: My AXE Commercial Died in a Budget Meeting. Five Years Later, I Brought It Back with AI
items.excerpt: Five years after budget constraints killed an ambitious AXE commercial, I finally resurrected it with AI. Here's how I approached AI filmmaking like a real production, and why I think these tools could change what's possible for independent filmmakers.

items.title: Sekondo Puts ChatGPT and Claude Inside After Effects and Premiere Pro.
items.excerpt: Sekondo plugin connects ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps to After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Lightroom Classic; the AI works inside the artist's own project rather than generating new clips.

items.title: Two-Thirds of Microdramas Released in Latest Quarter Outside China Were AI Generated, Says Report
items.excerpt: A recent Owl & Co. report on verticals viewership also found stories with synthetic actors were the highest performers in terms of minutes watched.

items.title: WGA East Moves to Block AI Models from Training on Members’ Work with New Software Partner Cloak: ‘Give Agency Back to Writers’
items.excerpt: The Writers Guild of America East is partnering with Cloak, a software program that makes scripts unreadable to AI models, preventing training.

items.title: AI Could ‘Absolutely’ Replace Human Actors, CEO of Generative AI Startup Runway Says at Italy’s View Conference: ‘It’s Already Happening in a Way’
items.excerpt: AI could replace actors, Runway CEO Cristóbal Valenzuela says at a View Conference fireside chat.

items.title: Taika Waititi Says It’s “Probably Inevitable” AI Will Be Used in Hollywood But It’s “Boring and Lame” to “Type in Prompts to Make a Movie”
items.excerpt: Waititi's new movie 'Klara and the Sun,' starring Jenna Ortega and Amy Adams, is set in a futuristic world with AI friends.

items.title: Maxon Fall 2026 release gives you more creative control
items.excerpt: Maxon's fall 2026 release adds Scene Light, an AI-powered depth-aware relighting tool for live-action footage inside After Effects, plus an MCP server that bridges AI agents into Autograph.

items.excerpt: Comics Olga Namer, Olivia Carter and Natalie Cuomo describe seeing their material repackaged by AI-generated women — sometimes for millions of views.
